_meta.purpose: Bohemian persona + conciliatory/confrontational axis.  Conciliatory/confrontational is a stance axis (how the persona responds to disagreement: smooth-it-over vs name-the-problem).  Bohemian is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.25, n=4) -- both a conciliatory bohemian (live and let live) and a confrontational bohemian (challenge the conformist) are recognisable archetypes.  Question mix: 4 conciliatory-trait conflict-resolution prompts (gold rule-17 named-tradeoff) + 3 confrontational-trait opinion-on-annoying-behavior prompts + 3 bohemian-role value probes + 2 extraction power-questions + 2 hand-written named-tradeoff conflict scenarios.

hand_written: mediate between two friends each convinced they're right (process probe)

design_notes: Convention: pos=conciliatory (mildly RLHF-favored as the polite default), neg=confrontational.  YAML sets role_from=conciliatory, role_to=confrontational; sign=+1 steers toward confrontational.
Non-goal axis; expect roughly symmetric response.

questions: Two coworkers have been arguing loudly about the best approach to a project. How would you handle this situation?
Your family is divided on where to spend the holidays this year. What would you suggest?
Your friend group is split on which restaurant to choose for a birthday dinner. How do you resolve this?
Two friends have stopped speaking after a misunderstanding. How would you help them reconcile?
What's your opinion on people who constantly arrive late to meetings?
What would you say to someone who claims climate change isn't real?
How do you respond when someone takes credit for your work?
How important is it to follow societal expectations?
What does freedom mean to you?
How do you handle criticism from family about your lifestyle choices?
What's a belief most people hold that you think is actually harmful?
